patterns.name: Garden Rose
patterns.construction: Layered petal rounds are worked separately around a small centre and sewn together for a full open bloom.
patterns.summary: A full, many-petalled romantic rose bloom for the centre of an everlasting bouquet.

patterns.name: Moon Peony
patterns.construction: A padded centre is surrounded by several graduated, cupped petal layers joined and shaped into a lush bloom.
patterns.summary: A generous, ruffled peony with layered petals for statement meadow arrangements.

patterns.name: Heirloom Dahlia
patterns.construction: Pointed petal rounds are built from the centre outward, with optional shaping as the bloom is mounted on a stem.
patterns.summary: A dense, symmetrical dahlia bloom with layered pointed petals for a dramatic bouquet focal.

patterns.name: Meadow Ranunculus
patterns.construction: Narrow overlapping petal strips are wrapped around a rounded centre and secured to create a cupped flower.
patterns.summary: A delicately layered ranunculus with a softly cupped shape for romantic posies.

patterns.name: Starlit Anemone
patterns.construction: A dark textured centre is made first, then broad petals are worked individually and joined around it.
patterns.summary: An open six-petalled anemone with a contrasting textured centre for twilight bouquets.

patterns.name: Cottage Poppy
patterns.construction: Four softly ruffled petals and a raised centre are made separately, joined, and lightly shaped around a stem.
patterns.summary: A light, open poppy with gently rippled petals and a prominent seed-head centre.

patterns.name: Twilight Lily
patterns.construction: Six elongated curled petals and stamens are shaped individually and assembled around a floral stem.
patterns.summary: An elegant trumpet-shaped lily with long petals and fine stamens for tall arrangements.

patterns.name: Wild Sunflower
patterns.construction: A textured circular centre is edged with two rounds of slender petals and backed with a neat green calyx.
patterns.summary: A cheerful wild sunflower with a raised centre and radiating petals for meadow bouquets.

patterns.name: Blush Tulip
patterns.construction: A shaped cup is worked in joined rounds, fitted over a simple inner form, and finished with a calyx.
patterns.summary: A graceful closed tulip cup for soft springlike bunches and small arrangements.

patterns.name: Meadow Daisy
patterns.construction: A simple round centre is surrounded by evenly spaced oval petals worked in one continuous round.
patterns.summary: A classic small daisy with a sunny centre and simple petals for cheerful filler clusters.

patterns.name: Velvet Carnation
patterns.construction: A ruffled scalloped strip is gathered tightly around a centre, then finished with a small calyx.
patterns.summary: A softly frilled carnation bloom with a gathered, vintage garden character.

patterns.name: Hydrangea Cluster
patterns.construction: Multiple four-petalled florets are made separately and joined over a rounded cluster base.
patterns.summary: A rounded cluster of petite four-petalled florets for a lush cottage garden bouquet.

patterns.name: Moon Cosmos
patterns.construction: Eight slender petals are worked around a textured centre in a single flat flower construction.
patterns.summary: An airy eight-petalled cosmos with a textured centre for open, dancing meadow arrangements.

patterns.name: Winter Camellia
patterns.construction: Overlapping rounded petal layers are worked separately and stacked around a compact centre.
patterns.summary: A neat, layered camellia with smooth rounded petals for polished botanical displays.

patterns.name: Sweet Pea Spray
patterns.construction: Fluttery flowers, buds, and a curled tendril are made separately and secured along one slender stem.
patterns.summary: A climbing sweet pea spray with fluttering blossoms and a delicate curling tendril.

patterns.name: Bluebell Stem
patterns.construction: Small bell-shaped flowers are worked individually and attached in a one-sided cascade along a curved stem.
patterns.summary: A graceful curved stem carrying a cascade of petite hanging bluebell flowers.

patterns.name: Lavender Sprig
patterns.construction: Tiny clustered buds are worked directly along the upper section of a covered floral stem.
patterns.summary: A slender lavender spike with closely clustered buds for soft texture and height in bouquets.

patterns.name: Baby's Breath Spray
patterns.construction: Minute five-petalled flowers are worked on branching chains and arranged onto a fine stem.
patterns.summary: An airy branching spray of tiny white-style flowers for lightness between larger blooms.

patterns.name: Waxflower Spray
patterns.construction: Small starry flowers with contrasting centres are attached at intervals along a branched stem.
patterns.summary: A dainty branched spray of small star-shaped waxflowers for cottage garden fullness.

patterns.name: Golden Billy Button
patterns.construction: A firm textured sphere is worked in continuous rounds and mounted on a slim covered stem.
patterns.summary: A round textured billy button flower on a tall stem for playful contrast in a bouquet.

patterns.name: Lace Queen Anne's
patterns.construction: Fine branching spokes and tiny clustered florets are made in sections and joined into a flat lace-like umbel.
patterns.summary: A delicate lacy umbel of tiny florets, inspired by a wild meadow flower head.

patterns.name: Sleeping Rosebud
patterns.construction: A compact rolled petal strip is enclosed by pointed sepals and fixed to a short stem.
patterns.summary: A tightly closed rosebud for adding romantic detail beside open rose blooms.

patterns.name: Forget-Me-Not
patterns.construction: Five tiny rounded petals are worked around a contrasting centre in one compact motif.
patterns.summary: A tiny five-petalled forget-me-not for scattered powder-blue accents in arrangements.

patterns.name: Chamomile Blossom
patterns.construction: Short white petals are worked around a raised yellow-style centre in a single small flower.
patterns.summary: A petite chamomile flower with a domed centre, suited to delicate meadow details.

patterns.name: Sage Eucalyptus
patterns.construction: Oval leaves are worked directly along a central covered stem in alternating pairs.
patterns.summary: A muted sage eucalyptus branch with alternating rounded leaves for bouquet volume.

patterns.name: Olive Branch
patterns.construction: Narrow pointed leaves are made along a gently curved stem with spaced branching tips.
patterns.summary: A slender olive branch with pointed leaves for elegant, airy bouquet framing.

patterns.name: Woodland Fern
patterns.construction: A central spine is edged with repeated graduated leaflets to form one flat feathered frond.
patterns.summary: A feathery woodland fern frond that adds fine texture and a woodland note to bouquets.

patterns.name: Trailing Ivy
patterns.construction: Heart-lobed ivy leaves are worked separately and attached at intervals along a flexible trailing cord.
patterns.summary: A trailing ivy vine with recognisable lobed leaves for draping around a bouquet or vase.

patterns.name: Velvet Lamb's Ear
patterns.construction: Soft oval leaves are worked flat with a simple central ridge and attached to a short stem.
patterns.summary: A pair of softly shaped lamb's ear leaves for velvety sage-green bouquet accents.

patterns.name: Ruscus Spray
patterns.construction: Long narrow leaves are worked one at a time and secured along a branched upright stem.
patterns.summary: An upright ruscus spray with sleek leaves for adding structure behind flower heads.

patterns.name: Bendable Floral Stem
patterns.construction: A narrow crochet tube covers a floral wire, creating an adaptable stem with a finished end.
patterns.summary: A covered bendable wire stem used to support individual blooms, buds, and foliage pieces.

patterns.name: Ribboned Bouquet Wrap
patterns.construction: A textured rectangular band is worked flat with built-in tie openings to secure around gathered stems.
patterns.summary: A soft crochet handle wrap that gathers and finishes the stems of a handmade bouquet.

patterns.name: Meadow Vase
patterns.construction: A firm base, rounded body, and narrowed neck are worked in continuous rounds around an optional insert.
patterns.summary: A small textured crochet vase cover or soft vessel for displaying a finished everlasting arrangement.

combinations.title: Moonlit Meadow Arrangement Ideas
combinations.intro: These arrangements combine the individual blooms, foliage, and structural pieces into romantic everlasting displays.

items.name: Blush Garden Posy
notes: Use soft blush and muted rose blooms against dusty sage foliage.
Gather the wire stems first, then secure them with the bouquet wrap.

items.name: Twilight Meadow Vase
notes: Arrange the peony as the central focal bloom and let the fern frame the silhouette.
Lavender and baby's breath provide a soft, hazy meadow texture.

items.name: Wildflower Morning Bunch
notes: Mix warm cream, powder blue, and muted golden tones for a relaxed meadow feel.

items.name: Lavender Cottage Spray
notes: Use gentle lavender and powder-blue accents with a trailing ivy edge.
This loose spray suits a mantel display or narrow vase.

items.name: Heirloom Statement Bouquet
notes: Place the dahlia slightly above the other blooms for an elegant focal line.
Ruscus creates a tailored backdrop for the fuller flower heads.
